name: Moscow on the Hill
neighborhoodOrCity: Cathedral Hill, St. Paul (371 Selby Ave.)
whatItIs: Russian restaurant and vodka lounge run by the Liberman family since the 1990s; pelmeni, vareniki, stroganoff, house-infused vodkas.
evidence: Own site shows current menu and asks guests to reserve; Visit Saint Paul (2026 site) lists current weekly hours.

name: Samarkand Restaurant
whatItIs: Uzbek restaurant opened in 2019 by a family from Samarkand; plov, samsa, shurpa. Macalester guide reports an adjoining Uzbek-Russian market.
evidence: The Mac Weekly describes a class dinner there on April 7, 2026; own site active.

name: Tasteful Delights Cafe and Tea Room
whatItIs: Family restaurant and bakery serving Russian, Ukrainian, Moldovan and American food, including mamaliga; catering and holiday meals.
evidence: Own site shows online ordering, delivery terms and a 2026 copyright.

name: Smak (formerly Russian Supermarket)
whatItIs: Eastern European grocery and deli serving Russian, Ukrainian, Moldovan and Bulgarian customers; renamed in 2017.
evidence: Undated directory listing with reviews; Macalester guide (updated May 2026) describes it but no dated page confirms current hours.

name: Minsk Market
whatItIs: European market and deli opened in 2000 by a woman from Minsk; staff from across the former Soviet Union.
evidence: Macalester guide note dated 10/08/2026: recently sold to a new owner and closed for renovations.

name: Arkady's Market
whatItIs: Eastern European market with fresh-baked bread and Russian-speaking staff.
evidence: Listed in Macalester guide (updated May 2026) without a dated visit; no own site found.

name: Zerkalo, Inc. (Zerkalo magazine, North Star newspaper, Russian Yellow Pages of Minnesota)
whatItIs: Russian-language publisher founded by Leonid Grichener in 1990-91; magazine, newspaper and business directory.
evidence: Own site lists North Star issues for January and February 2026.

name: Dance With Us America
whatItIs: Ballroom and Latin studio owned by Gene and Elena Bersten; home studio of Alan Bersten; runs free lessons for newly arrived boys, per Macalester guide.
evidence: Own site with 2026 copyright and current contact form.

name: Minnesota Ballet Theatre and School
whatItIs: Ballet school teaching the Vaganova method, co-directed by Kirill Bak-Stepanoff and Svetlana Bak-Gavrilova.
evidence: Only source opened is a 2021 article.

name: Sunflower Bilingual Daycare and Preschool
whatItIs: Bilingual Russian-English child care using Montessori practices; many teachers trained in the former USSR.
evidence: Own site (sunflowerdaycare.us) returned a verification block; described in Macalester guide without a date.

name: Russian Educational Center of Minnesota
whatItIs: Saturday Russian school founded 2002; language levels, AP-prep, theater, chess, art, cooking clubs, summer camp.
evidence: Own site shows current-year schedule and programs.

name: Igra. Unplugged / Russian Camp MN
whatItIs: Russian immersion camp founded 2015 by Tamara von Schmidt-Pauli; now runs as a day camp.
evidence: Own site describes current day camp and packing list.

name: Prime Language Services
whatItIs: Translation bureau owned since 2008 by a leader of the American Russian Center, per that center's site.
evidence: Mentioned in a leadership bio; business's own site not opened.

name: The Museum of Russian Art (TMORA)
whatItIs: Museum of Russian and Soviet-era art founded 2002 by Raymond and Susan Johnson; gift shop and education center.
evidence: Own site lists current programs, including a 2026 Maslenitsa event.
